title: Keep the Apple USB SD card reader alive after suspend
author: MrBazzieB
body:
## What

On 2013–2015 Intel Macs the built-in Apple USB Card Reader (`05ac:8406`) enumerates at boot, then stays powered off after suspend. A USB port reset cannot turn the chip back on. This was reproduced on MacBookPro12,1: after sleep the xHCI SuperSpeed port is present but empty, and `lsusb` never sees the reader until the PCH GPIO that supplies it is toggled.

Omarchy already ships `options usbcore autosuspend=-1` in `/etc/modprobe.d/omarchy-usb-autosuspend.conf`, but `usbcore` is built into the Arch kernel, so that file never applies.

## How

On matching DMI models (MacBookAir6/7, MacBookPro11, MacBookPro12,1):

- Write a Limine drop-in with `usbcore.quirks=05ac:8406:bk usbcore.autosuspend=-1`
- Pin the device awake with udev once it enumerates
- Install `acpi_call` and a post-resume sleep hook that calls Apple's XHCI `SPWR`/`SRST` methods (GPIO 44/24)
- Expose `omarchy cmd apple-sd-reader reset` for a manual recovery

A migration applies the same leaf on existing installs. New installs get it from `omarchy-apply-hardware`.

## Test plan

- [x] `./test/shell.d/apple-sd-reader-test.sh`
- [x] `./test/shell.d/privileged-heredoc-test.sh`
- [x] `./test/cli` (command metadata)
- [x] On MacBookPro12,1: after the reader dropped, ACPI `SPWR`/`SRST` brought it back and the card mounted as `sdb`

@@ -0,0 +1,166 @@
+#!/bin/bash
+
+# omarchy:summary=Revive or pin the built-in Apple USB SD card reader
+# omarchy:args={reset|status}
+# omarchy:requires-sudo=true
+# omarchy:hidden=true
+
+# The 2013–2015 Apple USB Card Reader (05ac:8406) sits on xHCI SuperSpeed and
+# often stays powered off after suspend. USB port reset cannot turn the chip
+# back on. Apple's XHCI ACPI methods SPWR/SRST toggle PCH GPIO 44 (power) and
+# GPIO 24 (reset). See install/hardware/apple/fix-sd-card-reader.sh.
+
+set -euo pipefail
+
+VID="05ac"
+PID="8406"
+ACPI_CALL="${OMARCHY_ACPI_CALL:-/proc/acpi/call}"
+
+die() {
+  echo "omarchy-cmd-apple-sd-reader: $*" >&2
+  exit 1
+}
+
+require_root() {
+  if (( EUID != 0 )); then
+    die "needs root (try: sudo omarchy cmd apple-sd-reader ${1:-reset})"
+  fi
+}
+
+find_reader() {
+  local d
+  for d in /sys/bus/usb/devices/*; do
+    [[ -f $d/idVendor && -f $d/idProduct ]] || continue
+    if [[ $(<"$d/idVendor") == "$VID" && $(<"$d/idProduct") == "$PID" ]]; then
+      printf '%s\n' "$d"
+      return 0
+    fi
+  done
+  return 1
+}
+
+keep_alive() {
+  local dev driver
+  modprobe usb-storage >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
+  modprobe uas >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
+
+  dev=$(find_reader) || return 1
+  echo on >"$dev/power/control" 2>/dev/null || true
+  echo -1 >"$dev/power/autosuspend" 2>/dev/null || true
+  echo 0 >"$dev/power/autosuspend_delay_ms" 2>/dev/null || true
+  echo 0 >"$dev/power/persist" 2>/dev/null || true
+
+  driver=$(basename "$(readlink -f "$dev/driver" 2>/dev/null)" 2>/dev/null || true)
+  if [[ $driver == "apple-mfi-fastcharge" ]]; then
+    basename "$dev" >"$dev/driver/unbind" 2>/dev/null || true
+  fi
+  return 0
+}
+
+acpi_ensure() {
+  [[ -e $ACPI_CALL ]] && return 0
+  modprobe acpi_call >/dev/null 2>&1 || return 1
+  [[ -e $ACPI_CALL ]]
+}
+
+acpi_eval() {
+  local method=$1
+  [[ -w $ACPI_CALL ]] || return 1
+  echo "$method" >"$ACPI_CALL" 2>/dev/null || return 1
+  tr -d '\0' <"$ACPI_CALL" >/dev/null
+}
+
+unmount_reader_disks() {
+  local host disk
+  host=$(find_reader) || return 0
+  for disk in /sys/block/sd*; do
+    [[ -e $disk ]] || continue
+    if [[ $(readlink -f "$disk") == "$host"* ]]; then
+      umount "/dev/$(basename "$disk")"* >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
+    fi
+  done
+}
+
+# Try the ACPI names used on MacBookPro12,1 and the shorter XHC alias.
+apple_gpio_power() {
+  local method
+  acpi_ensure || return 1
+  echo "omarchy-cmd-apple-sd-reader: cycling Apple SD power via ACPI SPWR/SRST"
+  unmount_reader_disks
+  for method in '\_SB.PCI0.XHC1.SPWR' '\_SB.PCI0.XHC.SPWR'; do
+    acpi_eval "$method 0" && break
+  done
+  for method in '\_SB.PCI0.XHC1.SRST' '\_SB.PCI0.XHC.SRST'; do
+    acpi_eval "$method 1" && break
+  done
+  sleep 2
+  for method in '\_SB.PCI0.XHC1.SPWR' '\_SB.PCI0.XHC.SPWR'; do
+    acpi_eval "$method 1" && break
+  done
+  for method in '\_SB.PCI0.XHC1.SPWR' '\_SB.PCI0.XHC.SPWR'; do
+    acpi_eval "$method 3" || true
+  done
+  sleep 0.3
+  for method in '\_SB.PCI0.XHC1.SRST' '\_SB.PCI0.XHC.SRST'; do
+    acpi_eval "$method 0" && break
+  done
+  sleep 1
+  return 0
+}
+
+wait_for_reader() {
+  local i
+  for i in $(seq 1 24); do
+    if find_reader >/dev/null; then
+      keep_alive || true
+      return 0
+    fi
+    sleep 0.25
+  done
+  return 1
+}
+
+status() {
+  local dev
+  if dev=$(find_reader); then
+    echo "reader      $(cat "$dev/product" 2>/dev/null)  $(basename "$dev")  power=$(cat "$dev/power/control" 2>/dev/null)"
+  else
+    echo "reader      not enumerated"
+  fi
+
+  if [[ -e $ACPI_CALL ]]; then
+    echo "acpi_call   loaded"
+  else
+    echo "acpi_call   not loaded"
+  fi
+
+  lsblk -o NAME,SIZE,TYPE,TRAN,VENDOR,MODEL,LABEL,MOUNTPOINT
+}
+
+cmd=${1:-reset}
+case $cmd in
+  status)
+    status
+    ;;
+  reset)
+    require_root "$cmd"
+    if find_reader >/dev/null; then
+      keep_alive || true
+      echo "omarchy-cmd-apple-sd-reader: card reader already on the bus; pinned awake"
+      status
+      exit 0
+    fi
+    if apple_gpio_power && wait_for_reader; then
+      echo "omarchy-cmd-apple-sd-reader: card reader came up"
+      status
+      exit 0
+    fi
+    echo "omarchy-cmd-apple-sd-reader: reader still missing" >&2
+    status
+    exit 1
+    ;;
+  *)
+    echo "usage: omarchy cmd apple-sd-reader {reset|status}" >&2
+    exit 2
+    ;;
+esac

+#!/bin/bash
+
+# omarchy:summary=Detect Intel Macs with the built-in Apple USB SD card reader (05ac:8406).
+
+product_name="${OMARCHY_DMI_PRODUCT_NAME:-/sys/class/dmi/id/product_name}"
+
+grep -qiE 'MacBookAir6,[12]|MacBookAir7,[12]|MacBookPro11,[1-5]|MacBookPro12,1' "$product_name" 2>/dev/null

@@ -0,0 +1,47 @@
+# The 2013–2015 Apple USB Card Reader (05ac:8406) often stays powered off after
+# suspend. usbcore is built into the Arch kernel, so /etc/modprobe.d cannot set
+# usbcore.autosuspend; the quirk has to live on the kernel command line.
+# ACPI SPWR/SRST (via acpi_call) re-powers the chip when USB reset cannot.
+
+if omarchy-hw-apple-sd-reader; then
+  echo "Detected Apple USB SD card reader Mac: $(cat "${OMARCHY_DMI_PRODUCT_NAME:-/sys/class/dmi/id/product_name}" 2>/dev/null || true)"
+
+  limine_conf="${OMARCHY_APPLE_SD_LIMINE_CONF:-/etc/limine-entry-tool.d/apple-sd-reader.conf}"
+  udev_rules="${OMARCHY_APPLE_SD_UDEV_RULES:-/etc/udev/rules.d/90-omarchy-apple-sd-reader.rules}"
+  sleep_hook="${OMARCHY_APPLE_SD_SLEEP_HOOK:-/usr/lib/systemd/system-sleep/omarchy-apple-sd-reader}"
+
+  omarchy-pkg-add acpi_call
+
+  sudo mkdir -p "$(dirname "$limine_conf")" "$(dirname "$udev_rules")" "$(dirname "$sleep_hook")"
+
+  sudo tee "$limine_conf" >/dev/null <<'EOF'
+# Generated by Omarchy for the Apple USB Card Reader (05ac:8406)
+KERNEL_CMDLINE[default]+=" usbcore.quirks=05ac:8406:bk usbcore.autosuspend=-1"
+EOF
+
+  sudo tee "$udev_rules" >/dev/null <<'EOF'
+# Pin the Apple USB Card Reader awake once firmware enumerates it.
+ACTION=="add", SUBSYSTEM=="usb", ATTR{idVendor}=="05ac", ATTR{idProduct}=="8406", TEST=="power/control", ATTR{power/control}="on"
+ACTION=="add", SUBSYSTEM=="usb", ATTR{idVendor}=="05ac", ATTR{idProduct}=="8406", TEST=="power/autosuspend", ATTR{power/autosuspend}="-1"
+EOF
+
+  sudo tee "$sleep_hook" >/dev/null <<'EOF'
+#!/bin/bash
+# After suspend the Apple USB SD reader often stays detached.
+if [[ $1 == "post" ]]; then
+  /usr/share/omarchy/bin/omarchy-cmd-apple-sd-reader reset >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
+fi
+EOF
+  sudo chmod 0755 "$sleep_hook"
+
+  if omarchy-cmd-present limine-mkinitcpio; then
+    sudo limine-mkinitcpio
+  fi
+
+  if omarchy-cmd-present udevadm; then
+    sudo udevadm control --reload
+    sudo udevadm trigger --subsystem-match=usb --action=add >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
+  fi
+
+  omarchy-state set reboot-required
+fi

@@ -0,0 +1,142 @@
+#!/bin/bash
+
+set -euo pipefail
+
+source "$(cd -- "$(dirname -- "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)/base-test.sh"
+
+leaf="$ROOT/install/hardware/apple/fix-sd-card-reader.sh"
+hw="$ROOT/bin/omarchy-hw-apple-sd-reader"
+cmd="$ROOT/bin/omarchy-cmd-apple-sd-reader"
+all="$ROOT/install/hardware/all.sh"
+manual="$ROOT/manual/44-mac-support.md"
+migration="$ROOT/migrations/1788508170.sh"
+
+grep -q 'apple/fix-sd-card-reader.sh' "$all" ||
+  fail "the Apple SD reader fix runs during hardware setup"
+grep -q 'usbcore.quirks=05ac:8406:bk' "$leaf" ||
+  fail "the install leaf puts the Apple reader quirk on the kernel command line"
+grep -q 'acpi_call' "$leaf" ||
+  fail "the install leaf installs acpi_call for SPWR/SRST"
+grep -q 'SPWR' "$cmd" ||
+  fail "the helper calls Apple XHCI SPWR"
+grep -q '05ac:8406' "$manual" ||
+  fail "Mac support documents the SD reader keep-alive"
+grep -q 'fix-sd-card-reader.sh' "$migration" ||
+  fail "a migration applies the Apple SD reader fix on existing installs"
+pass "the Apple SD reader fix is wired into hardware setup"
+
+test_tmp=$(mktemp -d)
+trap 'rm -rf "$test_tmp"' EXIT
+
+stub_bin="$test_tmp/bin"
+calls="$test_tmp/calls.log"
+dmi="$test_tmp/product_name"
+mkdir -p "$stub_bin" "$test_tmp/limine" "$test_tmp/udev" "$test_tmp/sleep"
+: >"$calls"
+
+printf 'MacBookPro12,1\n' >"$dmi"
+
+OMARCHY_DMI_PRODUCT_NAME=$dmi "$hw"
+pass "detector matches MacBookPro12,1"
+
+printf 'MacBookPro14,1\n' >"$dmi"
+if OMARCHY_DMI_PRODUCT_NAME=$dmi "$hw"; then
+  fail "detector ignores MacBookPro14,1"
+fi
+pass "detector skips Macs without the Apple USB reader"
+
+printf 'MacBookAir7,2\n' >"$dmi"
+OMARCHY_DMI_PRODUCT_NAME=$dmi "$hw"
+pass "detector matches MacBookAir7,2"
+
+cat >"$stub_bin/omarchy-hw-apple-sd-reader" <<'SH'
+#!/bin/bash
+exit 0
+SH
+
+cat >"$stub_bin/omarchy-hw-apple-sd-reader-miss" <<'SH'
+#!/bin/bash
+exit 1
+SH
+
+cat >"$stub_bin/omarchy-pkg-add" <<'SH'
+#!/bin/bash
+printf 'omarchy-pkg-add' >>"$TEST_LOG"
+printf '\t%s' "$@" >>"$TEST_LOG"
+printf '\n' >>"$TEST_LOG"
+SH
+
+cat >"$stub_bin/omarchy-cmd-present" <<'SH'
+#!/bin/bash
+[[ $1 == "limine-mkinitcpio" ]]
+SH
+
+cat >"$stub_bin/omarchy-state" <<'SH'
+#!/bin/bash
+printf 'omarchy-state' >>"$TEST_LOG"
+printf '\t%s' "$@" >>"$TEST_LOG"
+printf '\n' >>"$TEST_LOG"
+SH
+
+cat >"$stub_bin/sudo" <<'SH'
+#!/bin/bash
+printf 'sudo' >>"$TEST_LOG"
+printf '\t%s' "$@" >>"$TEST_LOG"
+printf '\n' >>"$TEST_LOG"
+"$@"
+SH
+
+cat >"$stub_bin/limine-mkinitcpio" <<'SH'
+#!/bin/bash
+echo 'limine-mkinitcpio' >>"$TEST_LOG"
+SH
+
+chmod +x "$stub_bin"/*
+
+limine_conf="$test_tmp/limine/apple-sd-reader.conf"
+udev_rules="$test_tmp/udev/90-omarchy-apple-sd-reader.rules"
+sleep_hook="$test_tmp/sleep/omarchy-apple-sd-reader"
+
+run_leaf() {
+  PATH="$stub_bin:$PATH" \
+    TEST_LOG="$calls" \
+    OMARCHY_PATH="$ROOT" \
+    OMARCHY_APPLE_SD_LIMINE_CONF="$limine_conf" \
+    OMARCHY_APPLE_SD_UDEV_RULES="$udev_rules" \
+    OMARCHY_APPLE_SD_SLEEP_HOOK="$sleep_hook" \
+    bash -euo pipefail -c 'source "$1"' _ "$leaf"
+}
+
+: >"$calls"
+run_leaf
+
+grep -Fq 'KERNEL_CMDLINE[default]+=" usbcore.quirks=05ac:8406:bk usbcore.autosuspend=-1"' "$limine_conf" ||
+  fail "leaf writes the Limine quirk drop-in"
+grep -q 'idProduct}=="8406"' "$udev_rules" ||
+  fail "leaf writes the udev keep-alive rule"
+grep -q 'omarchy-cmd-apple-sd-reader' "$sleep_hook" ||
+  fail "sleep hook calls the Apple SD reader helper"
+[[ -x $sleep_hook ]] || fail "sleep hook is executable"
+grep -Fxq $'omarchy-pkg-add\tacpi_call' "$calls" ||
+  fail "leaf installs acpi_call"
+grep -Fxq 'limine-mkinitcpio' "$calls" ||
+  fail "leaf rebuilds the boot image"
+grep -Fxq $'omarchy-state\tset\treboot-required' "$calls" ||
+  fail "leaf marks reboot required"
+pass "leaf installs cmdline, udev, sleep hook, and acpi_call"
+
+# Non-matching hardware: replace the detector on PATH with a miss.
+mv "$stub_bin/omarchy-hw-apple-sd-reader" "$stub_bin/omarchy-hw-apple-sd-reader.hit"
+cp "$stub_bin/omarchy-hw-apple-sd-reader-miss" "$stub_bin/omarchy-hw-apple-sd-reader"
+: >"$calls"
+rm -f "$limine_conf"
+PATH="$stub_bin:$PATH" \
+  TEST_LOG="$calls" \
+  OMARCHY_PATH="$ROOT" \
+  OMARCHY_APPLE_SD_LIMINE_CONF="$limine_conf" \
+  OMARCHY_APPLE_SD_UDEV_RULES="$udev_rules" \
+  OMARCHY_APPLE_SD_SLEEP_HOOK="$sleep_hook" \
+  bash -euo pipefail -c 'source "$1"' _ "$leaf"
+[[ ! -e $limine_conf ]] || fail "non-matching hardware does not write Limine config"
+[[ ! -s $calls ]] || fail "non-matching hardware is a no-op" "$(cat "$calls")"
+pass "leaf is a no-op on machines without the Apple USB reader"
